cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car won't start. Excellent: we can practise the walking route. Short strides, please; you'll last longer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's pouring, and my shoe leaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better still: proper wet-weather practice. Keep to the crown of the pavement; that's where the water drains off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The pavement's flooded. We have to turn back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, we can practise a retreat as well. Turn facing uphill, please. We are going to be exceptionally well prepared for a trip we haven't made.

reason: Replace generic cheerfulness with expert route instruction that turns each stated failure into a supposedly better rehearsal; keep the car trip goal visible.
